title: first-contact
objective: A new user with a cleared install: install state → import the example → configure → first real transition fires.

checks.goal: with nothing installed, the drawer says what to do next (copy since 544975fb: "Choose a story in Extensions → Story Orchestrator."; the old "Load a story from the extension settings." was the story-description fallback)
a brand-new chat has extraction enabled by default

steps.eval: const s = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().extraction.settings; if (!s.enabled) throw new Error(`extraction disabled by default on a fresh chat: ${JSON.stringify(s)}`); return s;

checks.goal: the memory profile is an install-level setting, so it is not stored per chat (the memory model controls sit in the collapsed Memory section since v2.7 plan 29, so the section is opened first: select-profile does not open it)

steps.eval: const details = document.getElementById('so-area-memory'); if (!details) throw new Error('the Memory section (#so-area-memory) is missing from the settings panel'); details.open = true; return { memorySectionOpen: details.open };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const global = rt.getGlobalSettings(); if (!global.extraction?.profileId) throw new Error('no install-wide memory profile after configuring'); const blob = SillyTavern.getContext().chatMetadata.story_orchestrator; const extras = Object.values(blob?.stories ?? {})[0]?.extras; if (extras?.extraction?.settings) throw new Error('the chat is still storing extraction settings'); return { profileId: global.extraction.profileId };

checks.goal: there is a first-run path that walks an empty install to playable
the wizard entry point is reachable by a real pointer, not only by a scripted click: both controls are hit-tested AND clicked with real pointer input at their centre, and each opens what it names
importing the shipped example story from the settings panel makes it playable
after configuring the memory model in the settings panel, the first real transition fires

steps.eval: const details = document.getElementById('so-area-memory'); if (!details) throw new Error('the Memory section (#so-area-memory) is missing from the settings panel'); details.open = true; return { memorySectionOpen: details.open };

const s = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().extraction.settings; if (!s.enabled || !s.profileId) throw new Error(`settings panel did not configure extraction: ${JSON.stringify(s)}`); return s;

send_generate.text: I push through the crowd and get close to the job board to read the postings.
I lean in and read the brightest notice on the board out loud to Arin.
I trace the seal on the Sun Ruins posting with a finger, still standing at the board.

checks.goal: the transition is announced to the player inline, not as a chat note: since W11 (T0 sessions 2026-10-01, 14-findings §6, 7b7dc620) "Also post a chat note" (announceTransitions) defaults OFF and the inline timeline carries the transition. Asserts the default is off, that no /comment note was posted, and that the level-1 player chip for the cp1 -> cp2 transition exists; cp2 has no player_name, so the chip reads the neutral player copy and never the author name "Accept the Mission". The inline window is widened to 200 for the read (install-wide display setting, put back by the journey's restoreConfig) so a long J1.6 cannot push the transition out of the default 20-message window

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setInlineSettings({ window: 200 }); await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, 500)); const snap = rt.getSnapshot(); if (snap.ui?.announceTransitions !== false) throw new Error(`the transition chat note is opt-in since W11, but this install reads announceTransitions=${JSON.stringify(snap.ui?.announceTransitions)}`); const notes = (SillyTavern.getContext().chat ?? []).filter((message) => message?.is_system && message?.extra?.type === 'comment'); if (notes.length) throw new Error(`a chat note was posted although "Also post a chat note" is off: ${JSON.stringify(notes.map((message) => String(message.mes).slice(0, 80)))}`); const items = Object.entries(snap.inline?.byMessage ?? {}).flatMap(([mesId, list]) => list.map((item) => ({ mesId: Number(mesId), ...item }))).filter((item) => item.id.startsWith('progress:transition:')); if (!items.length) throw new Error(`no inline transition chip under any message: inline level ${snap.inline?.level}, ${Object.keys(snap.inline?.byMessage ?? {}).length} message(s) with chips`); const leaked = items.filter((item) => item.text.includes('Accept the Mission')); if (leaked.length) throw new Error(`the author checkpoint name reached player copy: ${JSON.stringify(leaked.map((item) => item.text))}`); const chip = items[0]; if (chip.text !== 'The story moved on') throw new Error(`cp2 has no player_name, so the chip must read the neutral player copy: ${JSON.stringify(chip.text)}`); if (chip.level !== 1 || chip.persona !== 'player') throw new Error(`the transition chip is not level-1 player copy: ${JSON.stringify(chip)}`); return { chip: chip.text, mesId: chip.mesId, transitions: items.length, chatNotes: 0 };

checks.prompt: From opening SillyTavern with the extension installed, could you tell what to do to get a story running?
checks.anchors: 1 = no idea where to start · 3 = worked it out by poking around · 5 = the next step was obvious at every point

checks.prompt: Once you were playing, was it clear that the story was actually running (and would advance on its own)?
checks.anchors: 1 = no signal at all · 3 = guessed from the drawer · 5 = unmistakable
